description: Should an agent click, sign in to, or pay this domain? A risk score and verdict (likely_safe / caution / high_risk, or inconclusive when a check could not run) with plain-English reasons, from domain age, spam/abuse blocklists and the HTTPS certificate. Price $0.020 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data: verdict, risk_score (0-100), reasons[{risk, why}], age_days, blocklist_listings, blocklists_unanswered[], https_valid, not_checked[].
